bucket_name.description: Bucket name to migrate the data from.

id.description: Unique identifier for the data migration source.

provider.description: Cloud provider from which to migrate data. Use 'telnyx' if you want to migrate data from one Telnyx bucket to another.

access_key.description: AWS Access Key. For Telnyx-to-Telnyx migrations, use your Telnyx API key here.

secret_access_key.description: AWS Secret Access Key. For Telnyx-to-Telnyx migrations, use your Telnyx API key here as well.

source_region.description: For intra-Telnyx buckets migration, specify the source bucket region in this field.
